tag_line: See what injuries the driver would have suffered in your crash
title: Injury Mod
message:
BeamNG tells you the engine's broken and the axle snapped. This tells you what
happened to the person inside.

After a crash you get a list of actual injuries — "Skull fractured", "You broke
several ribs", "Internal bleeding" — with a body figure showing where you were
hurt and your chance of surviving.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              [ATTACH]1328854[/ATTACH]  
 

HOW IT WORKS:confused:

The mod reads the acceleration your car experiences during a crash, at the
game's full physics rate of 2000 samples per second, and runs it through
published crash-test research — the same kind used to give real cars their
safety ratings.

FEATURES:cool:
- Named injuries by body region, with severity and probability
- Body figure colour-coded by injury severity
- Survival chance, and a plain-language verdict
- Seatbelt toggle: belted with airbag, belted only, or unbelted
- Realistic mode: blackouts, blurred vision, muffled hearing and tinnitus,
  degraded vehicle control, and bleeding out over time
- Med kit — one per life, stops bleeding but doesn't mend bones
- Multi-impact crashes are reported per impact, in order


HOW TO USE:D

Install the zip, then add the app: pause menu → HUD Apps → edit your layout →
add "Crash Injury" and drag it where you want it.

Realistic mode is off by default. Turn it on with the toggle in the app.


HONEST LIMITATIONSo_O

 - Survival percentage is an estimate. Real survival depends on factors no
  simulation can see.

Feedback welcome, especially on whether the injuries feel right. Keep in mid this is the first version of the mod so you may have bugs :p
